user.title: Heating system
user.description: One heating system has one heat source. Setup asks for the heat source and your first room; everything else (presence and away, windows, guest mode, learning features) is on the Features page afterwards: Configure on this integration.

data_description.heat_source_entity: Switch: the boiler relay. Climate: the ESPHome / DIYLess thermostat climate entity. OTGW: the OpenTherm Gateway climate entity. It receives the winning room target. Climate and OTGW regulate on their own room temperature unless they read the Winning room temperature sensor (the ESPHome PID in thermostat.yaml does); see How it works in the docs (docs/how-it-works.md). What the thermostat must offer: Thermostat requirements (docs/thermostat.md).
data_description.ch_switch: Optional. On while a room that drives the heat source is heating; off while none is (rooms off or paused, or only rooms that heat along).
data_description.hysteresis: Switch only: start when a room is this far below its target, stop when it reaches it.

room.title: First room
room.description: Step 1 of 3 of your first room: name and temperatures. More rooms: Add room on the integration page.

data_description.overshoot_buffer: Added to the TRV targets only while this room drives the heat source.
data_description.drives_heat_source: Turn off for a room that may heat along but must never make the heat source run, such as a hallway that cools much faster than the rest of the house. Its TRVs still get its target and open while another room drives the heat source.

room_sensors.title: Sensors and valves
room_sensors.description: Sensors and valves for {room}. Window sensors come with the Windows feature (Configure > Features).

data_description.trvs: Optional. A room without TRVs only adds heat demand.
data_description.external_temperature_inputs: Optional. Number entities that receive the room temperature (for example Sonoff TRVZB or Shelly BLU TRV).
data_description.external_sensor_selects: Optional. Select entities that tell a TRV to use the external temperature (Sonoff TRVZB: temperature sensor select). Kept on the remote option while the room sensor works.

room_schedule.title: Schedule
room_schedule.description: Last step for {room}. A room always starts with a schedule: one preset all day, which you change later. Or turn scheduling off: then the room is yours. After this, turn on what else you want under Configure > Features.

experimental.title: Learning features (observe only)
experimental.description: All observe only: nothing here changes the heating. Every entity is optional; a feature runs once the entities it needs are set. What each feature does, what it needs and how mature it is: [Learning features]({docs_url})

data_description.exp_room: Warm-up advice and the night model follow this room. Its warm temperature is the morning target.
data_description.exp_comfort_weekday: When the room should be warm in the morning; the night prediction says when heating would have to start.
data_description.exp_outdoor: Needed for gas per degree-day and the night model.
data_description.exp_weather: Hourly forecast for the night prediction.
data_description.exp_people: zone.home or a count sensor. Days nobody was home are left out of the gas figures.
data_description.exp_gas: Total gas meter (m³), with long-term statistics.
data_description.exp_flame: With hot water active and central heating active: splits each day's gas into hot water and heating.
data_description.exp_dhw_rate: Leave empty: measured automatically from showers outside heating hours (0.019 until enough are collected). Set it only to pin your own value. Only days split from now on use a change.
data_description.exp_max_ch: Optional: the highest flow temperature the thermostat asks for (with thermostat.yaml the Central heating max flow temperature number; otherwise the boiler's maximum CH setpoint, if the boiler really stops there). Stored with each warm-up so warm-ups with a different limit are not compared, and the PID advice limits scale with it; a change shows in the evening report.
data_description.exp_flow_request: Optional: the flow temperature the thermostat asks the boiler for (with thermostat.yaml the Central heating requested flow temperature sensor). Stored with each warm-up next to the real flow, to check that the flow stays at the limit; collected for a heating curve later.
data_description.exp_member_id: Optional: the boiler's OpenTherm member ID, a number that identifies its maker (with thermostat.yaml the Boiler member ID sensor). Shown in the evening report; later used to suggest a boiler profile, which you always confirm.
data_description.exp_max_capacity: Optional: the boiler's maximum capacity in kW as it reports it (with thermostat.yaml the Boiler maximum capacity sensor). With the minimum modulation it gives the boiler minimum power.
data_description.exp_min_modulation: Optional: the boiler's minimum modulation in % as it reports it (with thermostat.yaml the Boiler minimum modulation sensor).
data_description.exp_min_power: Leave empty: measured from warm-ups where the boiler cycles because the room needs less than its smallest flame. Set it only to pin the value from the boiler manual (minimum load, in kW). Without it, a boiler that reports its maximum capacity and minimum modulation gives the value; otherwise it is measured. Shown in the evening report; buffer rooms will use it later.
data_description.exp_dhw_setpoint: Optional: a sensor that shows the boiler's hot water temperature setting. Pick a sensor, not a number or slider you can change: if Home Assistant can change this value, the thermostat may send it to the boiler, and some boilers stop working when that happens. Only read, never written. Stored with each gas day; a change shows in the evening report.
data_description.exp_kp: Kp, Ki and Kd of a firmware PID (for example ESPHome). With all three set, warm-ups get tuning advice. See Thermostat requirements (docs/thermostat.md in the repository).
data_description.exp_integral: Optional PID integral sensor (ESPHome reports it x100).
data_description.exp_auto_apply: Off by default. On: after each warm-up the advice is written to the Kp or Ki number (one value, 10% at most, within the limits); after 2 more warm-ups in the same outdoor band the change stays only when the problem got smaller, otherwise it is reverted and never tried again. Every change shows in the evening report. Needs all three PID numbers.
data_description.exp_notify: The 21:00 report always goes to the Learning features report sensor (show it with a Markdown card). Events only: a notification only when something happened that day (a PID change applied, kept or reverted, a boiler setting changed, a feature became ready for stable, an unreadable file moved aside). Summary: three lines every evening, plus events. Full report: the whole report, as before 1.7.0.
data_description.exp_gas_price_before6: Optional, shown next to the night prediction (for example Frank Energie).

It receives the winning room target. Climate and OTGW regulate on their own room temperature unless they read the Winning room temperature sensor (the ESPHome PID in thermostat.yaml does); see How it works in the docs (docs/how-it-works.md). What the thermostat must offer: Thermostat requirements (docs/thermostat.md).
data_description.ch_switch: Optional. On while a room that drives the heat source is heating; off while none is (rooms off or paused, or only rooms that heat along).
data_description.hysteresis: Switch only: start when a room is this far below its target, stop when it reaches it.
data_description.off_temperature: Sent to the heat source and TRVs when nothing should heat (frost protection).
data_description.temperature_without_schedule: Held by a room that has no schedule yet, and by every room with a schedule while schedules are suspended (a change by hand starts that room's schedule again). Make a schedule or turn scheduling off for each room.
data_description.skip_unchanged_writes: Saves TRV batteries. When off, the heartbeat also resends every TRV target.
data_description.external_temp_heartbeat: How often room temperatures are resent to TRV external inputs, even when unchanged (Sonoff TRVZB falls back to its own sensor after 2 hours).

data_description.presence_entity: home / on means somebody is home. Unknown counts as home.
data_description.away_mode: Rooms that are set to heat go off, or are lowered to their eco temperature.

features.title: Features
features.description: Turn on what you want; everything that is off stays out of sight (no settings page, no entities, no card section). Settings of a feature you turn off are kept. Learning features: {docs_url}

data_description.feature_presence: Rooms go off or to eco when everybody leaves, and changes by hand end. Needs a presence entity.
data_description.feature_windows: A room pauses while a window or door in it is open. Window sensors are set per room.
data_description.feature_guest_mode: A Someone is home switch that ignores presence, for visitors Home Assistant doesn't track.
data_description.experimental: Learn how the house heats: warm-ups, nights, gas use, PID advice. They change nothing unless you allow it.
data_description.feature_sun_assist: On a sunny morning, rooms that get sun wait for the sun instead of warming up, unless it is still dark at the check.

sun_assist.title: Sun assist
sun_assist.description: A switch point in the morning window to a preset warmer than the hold temperature, in a room that gets sun: on a sunny forecast the room holds the hold temperature instead. With a lux sensor, the preset still starts at the check time when it reads dark; without one the forecast alone decides, and the room holds until its next switch point.

data_description.sun_forecast: The hourly forecast from the switch point to the check time decides: sunny when at least half of those hours are in Counts as sunny.
data_description.sun_conditions: Forecast conditions that count as sunny.
data_description.sun_rooms: Only these rooms wait for the sun.
data_description.sun_hold_temperature: Held instead of the preset while waiting. Presets at or below it are not affected.
data_description.sun_window_start: Switch points from this time on can wait for the sun.
data_description.sun_window_end: Switch points from this time on never wait.
data_description.sun_lux_sensor: Optional. Without it, sun assist trusts the forecast only, which is weaker.
data_description.sun_dark_below: At the check time the preset starts when the lux sensor reads less than this (or can't be read).
data_description.sun_check_delay: Time after the switch point when the lux sensor is checked.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Step 3 of 3 for {room}. A room always starts with a schedule: one preset all day, which you change on the card later. Or turn scheduling off: then the room is yours, with presets, targets and your own automations as before.

error.max_below_min: Maximum must be higher than minimum.
error.preset_out_of_range: Must be between minimum and maximum.
error.name_exists: A room with this name already exists.

options.scheduling_off: Scheduling off: I control this room myself

pause_room.name: Pause room
pause_room.description: Hold a room off until resumed, keeping its mode and target.

config_entry_id.name: Heating system
config_entry_id.description: Optional. Only rooms of this heating system.

experimental_report.name: Learning features report
experimental_report.description: Post the learning features report now (it is also posted every evening at 21:00).

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Save a room's week schedule, or turn scheduling on or off for the room.

week.name: Week
week.description: Seven days, Monday first; each day a list of switch points {time: HH:MM on 15 minute steps, preset}. Optional when turning scheduling off, or on again with the schedule the room already has.

scheduling.name: Scheduling
scheduling.description: on: the room follows the schedule. off: the room is yours, as before v2.

resume_schedule.name: Back to schedule
resume_schedule.description: End a manual change on a room, so it follows its schedule again.

suspend_schedules.name: Suspend schedules
suspend_schedules.description: Every room with a schedule holds the temperature without schedule until schedules are resumed. A change by hand starts that room's schedule again.

resume_schedules.name: Resume schedules
resume_schedules.description: Rooms with a schedule follow it again.

set_override.name: Set manual change
set_override.description: Change a room with a schedule by hand: a temperature or a preset, for how long, and whether it stays when everyone leaves.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: The temperature to hold. Give this or a preset.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: The preset to hold (eco, warm, a preset you added, or off). Give this or a temperature.

until.name: Until
until.description: next_change (default): until the next schedule change. permanent: until Back to schedule.

duration.name: For
duration.description: Instead of until: for this long, at most 7 days (for example 1 or 3 hours).

keep_when_away.name: Keep when everyone is away
keep_when_away.description: Off (default): the change ends when everyone leaves. On: it stays, also while everyone is away (for a visitor Home Assistant doesn't track).

set_guest_mode.name: Set guest mode
set_guest_mode.description: Treat the house as occupied, whatever presence says, so every room runs its schedule (for visitors Home Assistant doesn't track).

until.name: Until
until.description: Optional end time. Without it, guest mode stays on until switched off.

duration.name: For
duration.description: Instead of an end time: for this long.

no_schedule.message: {room} has no schedule: make one or turn scheduling off

schedules_blocked.message: Schedules can't be used right now (see Repairs), so {room} can't be changed

no_week.message: {room} has no schedule to turn on: send a week

override_target_or_preset.message: Give a temperature or a preset, not both

scheduling_off.message: {room} has scheduling off: set its target or preset directly

guest_end_in_past.message: The end time of guest mode is in the past

feature_off.message: {feature} is off for {system}: turn it on under Configure > Features

rooms_without_schedule.title: Rooms without a schedule in {system}
rooms_without_schedule.description:
These rooms have no schedule and hold {temperature} °C: {rooms}.

Make a schedule for each (one preset all day is enough to start), or turn scheduling off for a room you control yourself.

schedules_blocked.title: Schedules of {system} can't be used
schedules_blocked.description: {reason}. Every room holds the temperature without schedule, and the schedule file is left as it is. Restore a backup or install the version that wrote it.
